Waterfall explanation of one prediction

Source: R/pred-shap.R
wgh_plot_waterfall.Rd

Waterfall explanation of one prediction

Usage

wgh_plot_waterfall(shap, row = 1, max_features = 8, ...)

Arguments

shap

A wgh_shap object.

row

Row to explain.

max_features

Features shown (the rest are summed).

...

Display options (see wgh_plot_options()).

Value

A ggplot object. Bars start at the baseline (the average prediction) and each feature pushes the prediction up (orange) or down (blue) until it reaches the prediction for this child.

Examples

# \donttest{
fit <- lm(height ~ age + baz + sex, data = growdat)
X <- growdat[1:50, c("age", "baz", "sex")]
sh <- wgh_shap(fit, X, bg_X = growdat[sample(nrow(growdat), 50), c("age", "baz", "sex")])
wgh_plot_waterfall(sh, row = 1)

wgh_plot_waterfall(sh, row = 2, title = "Why this prediction?")

# }
